topic: Auto-expiry alerts for work permits and visas — how the dashboard surfaces renewals 30/60/90 days out
format: Lead with a quote or question from a customer, then explain the feature built in response
post:
"We found out a visa expired because the employee got stopped at a border checkpoint."

That message came from an HR manager at a Muscat trading company. By then, the damage was done — travel blocked, project delayed, emergency filing fees paid.

The permit had been sitting in a spreadsheet no one checked.

SmartPRO Hub built auto-expiry alerts specifically for situations like this. The dashboard flags every work permit and visa at 90, 60, and 30 days before expiry — automatically, with no manual tracking required.

HR managers see the full workforce status in one view. Who's expiring this month. Who's coming up next quarter. What's already in the renewal queue.

No spreadsheet. No WhatsApp reminder chains. No checkpoint surprises.

For companies managing 20, 50, or 200+ employees across Oman and the GCC, this is the difference between proactive compliance and reactive firefighting.

Work permit tracking GCC teams actually use — built into the same platform handling WPS payroll, Omanization quotas, and Ministry of Labour filings.

One missed renewal can ground a project. The fix shouldn't require a full-time tracker.
